display_observations.notes: Record display presence separately from editable-control coverage. Class names are GUI evidence, not protocol offsets, scales or independent meter counts; overlapping parent/child widgets can share one display. Processing/mode LED correlations, where captured, remain in their separate control observations.

parameters.notes: BBD Chorus. Each listed control was wheeled to both ends in the vendor panel and moved only its own byte; min/max are the raw limits seen. Raw units: no physical unit is claimed. Switches and selectors were clicked instead (2026-11-21); each changed only its own byte and min/max are the values seen; names and value meanings were read from the per-state pictures. Vibrato/Chorus: 0 chorus, 1 vibrato. Stereo Type: 0 basic, 1 wide, 2 split, 3 cross. Bytes 6 and 7 did not answer wheel or click. Unmapped bytes are written back unchanged. Read layout on this device: loaded alone into an empty rack through this project's server, the cat 0x07 reply was one flag byte then the block and nothing else (one instance per reply)

implementations.notes: This project's runtime contract for this device: commands.parameters is the parameter block antelope.protocol.afx_parameter_effect() serves for this profile; its own status, notes and evidence record the device trials. The frame, state query, bypass and loads are device-wide, in the device profile's afx_inserts. Field options, where present, are the labels of the orion_studio_sc.json control encoding at the same block offset (Orion captures, not observed on this device); this project's own value meanings stay in commands.parameters.notes.
